sloka: एष पूर्वस्य देवस्य लोककर्तुः सनातनः ।शरस्तेजोमयो वत्सा येन वै भयमागतम् ।। ७.६९.२६ ॥
transliteration: eṣa pūrvasya devasya lokakartuḥ sanātanaḥ ।śarastejomayo vatsā yena vai bhayamāgatam ।। 7.69.26 ॥

translations.english: Brahma further explained that this radiant arrow, which caused their fear, is the eternal weapon of the ancient god, the creator of the worlds.
